original: Alternatively, if your title performs either full screen effects or rendering after tiling, only one front buffer texture is needed, plus one scene resolve texture. The memory requirements are the same as for two front buffers, but the need to switch between front buffers at every frame is eliminated. Simply perform the final Resolve to the single front buffer after calling SynchronizeToPresentationInterval, and there is no tearing. The PredicatedTiling sample in the XDK demonstrates this configuration, which is described in more detail in the Advanced Predicated Tiling Topics white paper.
pt: Alternatively, se seu titulo executa qualquer um cheio tela efeitos ou renderizacao apos repeticao, somente um frente buffer textura e necessario, mais um cena resolver textura. The memoria requisitos sao o mesmo como para dois frente buffers, mas the precisa para switch entre frente buffers em cada quadro e eliminated. simplesmente executar the final resolver para the unico frente buffer apos chamando SynchronizeToPresentationInterval, and ha no tearing. The PredicatedTiling amostra em the XDK demonstrates este configuracao, que e descrito em mais detalhe em the avancado predicado repeticao topicos branco paper.
